highlights.title: Argentine leader threatens to sanction oil firms working off Falklands
highlights.summary: Javier Milei reiterates his country's claim on the British overseas territory, saying the "winds of change" favour it.

highlights.title: Moraes acusa Mendonça de agir para favorecer 'grupos políticos', pede providências de Fachin e agrava crise no STF
highlights.summary: Alexandre de Moraes usou controverso Inquérito das Fake News para requisitar da PF relatórios de inteligência contra colega. 'Aos olhos da sociedade, o tribunal parece estar implodindo', diz cientista política.

highlights.title: Argentina’s Milei threatens sanctions over Falklands oil drilling
highlights.summary: Argentina’s President Javier Milei has threatened sanctions against oil companies operating off the Falklands.

highlights.title: Arsenal sell Martinelli to Al-Hilal in post-transfer deadline day deal
highlights.summary: Brazil forward Gabriel Martinelli transfers to Saudi Pro League side Al-Hilal from Premier League champions Arsenal.

highlights.title: STF fixa R$ 5 mil como novo teto de renda para Justiça gratuita
highlights.summary: Corte também derrubou regra do TST que admitia autodeclaração de pobreza e estendeu o novo critério a todos os ramos do Judiciário

highlights.title: Mladic’s body arrives to full military honours in Serbia
highlights.summary: The body of war criminal Ratko Mladic has arrived in Belgrade, where he received a full military guard.
